QUOTE: Python does not embed or re-implement the engine. It loads `librentropic.so` with `ctypes` and calls the C ABI declared in `include/entropic/entropic.h`. No pybind11, cffi, or Python C extension is involved.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states ctypes loading librentropic.so as the mechanism and explicitly rules out any compiled extension module.
